title: Room pieces and presets
description: What stands in the room and where (pieces), and whole-room presets that choose, for each piece, its product, finish and place. Products and their options are in products.json. Coordinates are metres: x from the left wall, z from the window wall. Rotation is in degrees: 0 = back toward the window wall, 90 = back against the left wall, 180 = back toward the door wall, 270 = back against the right wall.

default.description: The id of the preset a first visit starts with.

palette.description: The colours shown for each preset in the Presets panel, as [piece or product id, option group].

pieces.description: The room's pieces, in order: a piece placed relative to another comes after it.

place.description: Where a piece stands, as clear distances from its footprint to the walls: one of left / right / x (the centre) and one of window / door / z (the centre). Distances to walls keep a piece put when the room's measurements or the piece's model change.

y.description: Stands on something this high (the windowsill), instead of the floor.

label.description: Shown in the edit bar and the info card, e.g. Sofa, Chair 1.

product.description: The product id it starts as (before any preset).

alternatives.description: Products it can be switched to under Model.

present.description: Whether it's in the room before any preset says otherwise.

optional.description: Can be added and removed in Edit.

match.description: Follows this piece's finish until it's given its own (the pouf matches the sofa).

attach.description: Placed by another piece: in front of its window end (the pouf by the sofa), or with end: door, in front of the seat at its door end (the coffee table).

front.description: Clear gap from that piece's front (its seat, measured on the model).

past.description: end: window: how far it reaches beyond that piece's window end.

hostWindow.description: While this piece is in the room, the other stands this far from the window wall, to make room.

seat.description: end: door: centred this far in from that piece's door end (the middle of its seat).

clear.description: end: door: at least this far past that piece's footprint (in front of the In Situ's chaise).

around.description: At an offset from another piece's centre (chairs around the table), so they move together.

movable.description: False for a piece that stays where it's placed (the plant on the windowsill): it isn't dragged in Edit or kept inside the room's walls.

id.description: Also its link: …#preset=<id>. (none is taken: the empty room.)

summary.description: The short line under its name in the Presets panel.

note.description: The whole preset in a sentence (tooltip).

pieces.description: By piece id, or by product id for every piece of that product (the four chairs). Pieces it doesn't name keep what they have.

choices.description: Option group id → option id, as in the product's options file. Groups left out take the default; a piece that matches another and has no choices follows it.
